customers_say: Customers find the digital lock to be of good quality, with positive feedback about its installation and functionality. They appreciate its appearance and consider it worth the price, while also praising the customer service.

reviews.author: GS
reviews.title: Useless product
reviews.body: Very disappointed. Lock kept getting stuck. We had to open with keys. One day the sky also stopped working. Godrej people refused to take any responsibility and we had to cut our door to open it
